origin: User: 'what am i supposed to do if price crosses the entry before 9:30' then 'can you test what happens if i enter anyways'. Written before any chase trade was computed. Already known from iv_wall_hours: OCO resting overnight (entry at the cross itself) = -0.037R, no edge.
status: SPENT DATA, INFORMATION ONLY. NQ 2011-2026 picked the strategy; the frozen rule (skip days that open outside the walls, orders 09:35-15:30, flat 15:55) is not changed by anything here.
base: frozen IV-wall break walls (prior RTH close +/- sigma, 0.4 sigma stop, 2R target, VXN), NQ, frozen research_loop_nq.eval costs (market entry: 1 tick base / 2 ticks stress), random-direction twins with 40 coin seeds

entry.E0900: at the open of the 09:00 ET 1m bar, if that price is beyond a wall: market entry in the break direction
entry.E0930: at the 09:30 open, if it is beyond a wall (= every day the frozen rule skips as 'opened outside'): market entry in the break direction
entry.E0935: day opened outside a wall and the 09:35 open is still beyond that wall: market entry in the break direction

bracket.printed: the stop and target the morning printout shows for that wall (stop = wall -/+ 0.4 sigma, target = wall +/- 0.8 sigma, tick-snapped as the engine). Risk = entry to printed stop, so RR is below 2. No trade if the entry is already at or past the printed target.
bracket.same_size: stop 0.4 sigma from the entry price, target 0.8 sigma from the entry price (the usual risk and 2R, re-anchored on the fill)

chase.exits: stop / target / flat at the open of the last 5m bar (15:55, 12:55 half days), engine check_bar rules on 1m bars (stop wins ties, target needs a tick through). One chase trade per session. E0900 runs on Globex 1m bars until 09:30, then the RTH bars.

split_of_frozen_trades: the frozen rule's own trades (days that open inside), split by whether the traded wall had already been crossed in Globex between 18:00 ET and 09:30 (price came back inside before the open) or not. Information on whether an overnight cross that reverses 'doesn't count'.
windows: dev 2011-2018, val1 2019-2021, val2 2022-2026-08-14; reported separately and pooled

reading.chase: Entering anyway is worth doing only if a cell has pooled mean net R > 0 with trade-bootstrap 95% CI low > 0, stress > 0, edge over coin > 0 and a positive mean in all three splits. Six cells are read, so one passing cell alone is weak. Otherwise: keep skipping.
reading.either_way: the frozen rule stays as it is; anything that passes here is a forward-journal tag, not a rule change
